verdict.rationale: Decagon's Agent Operating Procedures let teams define agent logic in natural language, the way human agents are trained with SOPs. That implies procedural, multi-step handling rather than single canned replies, and the email channel is said to handle complex customer threads. None of the evidence explicitly documents the agent asking clarifying questions or running step-by-step troubleshooting. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of clarifying-question behavior, explicit multi-step troubleshooting flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of resolution quality.

support.subject: As a support leader, the agent asks clarifying questions and works through multi-step troubleshooting instead of dumping one canned answer

citations.quote: you can define agent behavior in natural language, the same way you train human agents with SOPs
Non-technical teams can architect and iterate on agent logic with Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs)
